candidates.edits: Changed warriors insert ADD DI,2000h(A)/3000h(B), MOV AX,CCCC, MOV DX,AX, two INT86, MOV DI,[BX] after ES and initial SP setup. Existing MOV DX,stride and MOV AX,1FFF restore those registers. Worker/source and A zombie entry rebased using labels. Exactly six added startup opcodes,15 bytes per changed warrior; no recurring-loop edits.
candidates.hypothesis: Spend otherwise-unused two INT86 charges on512 lethal bytes before slow starters leave their loaded source. Paint is outside own quantized source bucket, then original recursive painter resumes.
candidates.blast_geometry: For quantized bucket base Q=floor(initial AH/3Ch)*3C00h modulo65536: A paints Q+4C52h..Q+4E51h; B paints Q+4052h..Q+4251h. Own loaded source lies Q..Q+3CEBh at worst for these236/217-byte warriors. DI has no0FFB low-offset wrap in initial bucket set. Captured B band20h/34h produces still-farther bursts. MOV DI,[BX] works with0/1/2 remaining charges.
candidates.failure_modes: Six startup opcodes delay normal replication; blast may hit a friendly captured Zombie or teammate. Static placement buckets are only launch safety, not a guarantee of useful enemy hits. Captured Zombies can have fewer charges, reducing burst offense while pointer restoration remains correct.
candidates.verification: Official Cpu restricted-memory charged fixture2/1: A/B alive20k opcodes at five placements; first MOVSB153/469 versus baseline147/463, launch counts74/38 unchanged. Each512-byte target was seeded NOP and asserted entirelyCCCC immediately after second INT86. Source Cpu.int86 decrements a charge then runs64 stosdw operations; DF clear makes DI+256 per charge.

candidates.hypothesis: If advertised Zombie pointer7A00h is untouchedCCCC sentinel, skip blind patching of fixed arenaCCCF..CCD5. Saves four startup opcodes in sentinel case and avoids ungrounded writes; existing patch behavior retained for all other values.
candidates.edits: A adds CMP BX,CCCC / JE no_zombie_pointer immediately after MOV BX,[7A00]. A worker and zombie offsets use labels; copied worker bytes unchanged. B exact original.
candidates.failureModes: Non-sentinel corrupt pointer still patches arbitrary bytes. Delaying valid capture by two instructions may regress a compatible old Zombie context. Sentinel-skip removes a small amount of incidental fixed-address offense.
